## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (or I explained why it can't)
- [ ] No new dependency — or I explained why it's needed and its licence is GPL-3.0 compatible
- [ ] Nothing here scrapes, bypasses DRM/paywalls, or plays music a source hasn't explicitly licensed for streaming
- [ ] No secrets, API keys or tracking/analytics added
- [ ] UI changes are keyboard-accessible and checked at phone width
- [ ] Docs / CHANGELOG updated if users would notice
